angle: How thick a card should be, and what gsm means in the hand
caption:
People always tap the edge of a 300 gsm card with their thumb before they read a single word.

· 80 gsm bends like standard office bond
· 250 gsm holds upright against a frame
· 300 gsm gives craft board a crisp snap
· Textured fibres absorb pigment without bleed
